title: General mathematics from occurrence and smooth-exponent interleaving
objective: Develop the original smooth-number exponent-stream and occurrence-count observations into a substantive general mathematical result. Explain higher-dimensional behavior with a structural or quantitative theorem and a concrete consequence for fixed-prime ordering or random access. Require a complete uniform proof, reproducible verification, primary prior-art comparison and an honest publication assessment beyond the existing manuscripts. Isolated patterns, known corollaries or a plan alone do not complete the goal.
scope: Fixed-prime smooth-number ordering and exponent streams; general positive-weight mathematics where it explains those observations. No prime-generation, factoring or ML architecture objective.

results: The ordinary occurrence partner of one exponent stream is the rank on the remaining coordinate face; its two-pass return is preserved established background.
For distinct exponent vectors a,b with later rank j, product_i(1+abs(a_i-b_i))<=2(j-1). Their difference therefore involves at most floor(log2(2j-2)) coordinates.
Signs of primitive mixed-sign comparison vectors z with product_i(1+abs(z_i))<=2n determine the full n-term prefix. The argument charges the first rank affected when crossing a comparison wall.

The n-term prefixes on all coordinate faces of dimension at most 1+floor(log2 n) determine the full n-term prefix. This is uniqueness under a joint-realizability promise, not a face-compatibility criterion or a running-time improvement.

For every k and every finite M, two 2k-prime systems can have identical M-term words on all proper faces and differ in the full word by rank binomial(3k,k). The first 2k-1 prime bases can be shared. The prime realization uses established Bertrand-based finite approximation.
The worst-case face dimension required for n-term reconstruction is Theta(log n), uniformly in ambient dimension. Upper and lower leading constants differ; exact thresholds remain open in this study.

A four-prime witness agrees on every proper face through 1000 terms and differs at rank 10. Exact rational lower-bound fixtures in dimensions 2,4,6,8,10 support the general argument without substituting for its proof.

primary_comparison.scope: Chapter 3 divisor-box, product-ground and difference-matrix arguments are established. The dimension-independent comparison bound and face hierarchy require a precise full comparison.

Maclagan Section 3 and Lemma 4.1 establish primitive/flippable pairs, complement symmetry and coherent comparison walls on the Boolean domain. The lower construction's Boolean core is known machinery.
Section 3 and Theorem 3 concern central pairs and comparisons determining coherent subset orders. The implication, if any, for ordinary monomial prefix face dimension is unresolved.
Vietri Property 2.6 and Proposition 6.2 are established fixed-degree and finite prime-realization results. No new prime-realization principle is claimed.

The previous full-paper audit credits Sections 5-6, Propositions 4-7 for feasible cones, reduced comparisons and strict-prefix enumeration. Their implication for the new dimension bound still needs theorem-level comparison.
Adams-Watters's planar threshold is credited and checked, not presented as new.

first_iteration.decision: Continue the original mathematical track. The logarithmic reconstruction hierarchy is proved internally but its novelty and significance are not yet established. Preserve it as a candidate and supporting mechanism; do not declare the goal achieved or begin a contribution manuscript from these checks alone.
next_actions: Compare the complete finite-ordering and coherent Boolean-order arguments at theorem level, including Vasiliev-Pavlov and citation descendants, to decide whether the hierarchy is already stated or directly implied.

Study the minimum rank at which a comparison involving k coordinates can affect the word. A sharp threshold or substantially tighter dimension bound would strengthen the current logarithmic-order result; test conjectures before broad computation.

Determine whether the actual occurrence and zero-mask encodings reduce the face-data bill or permit a useful reconstruction/certification algorithm. Charge the number and length of faces, arithmetic precision and any enumeration; uniqueness alone is not an algorithmic advantage.

Pursue a paper only after a genuine gap and a useful general consequence survive the primary comparison. If this package is a known corollary, credit it and use it to select the next arithmetic or sequence question.

policies: Preserve core kernels, previous manuscripts and research artifacts, including the separately paused ML track.
Never send emails, author queries, messages to others or journal submissions.
Publish only an explicit privacy-reviewed research file list on the already authorized main branch.
Keep exploratory probes, machine-specific metadata and private audit records under ignored results/local or results/private.
The documented Elizalde-Galvan final-version working assumption remains in force; it supplies no novelty evidence.
